query: UPDATE contacts SET account_pid = $2, owner_ref = $3, job_title = $4, given_name = $5, family_name = $6, stakeholder_role = $7, influence = $8, interest = $9, marketing_consent = $10, consent_changed_at = CASE WHEN $11 THEN $12 ELSE consent_changed_at END WHERE id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
